tests.name: A1: real Host dispatch reaches plugin before domain proposal
A2: commit without a new confirmation is denied
A3: real dispatch issues grant before commit and persists exactly one trip
B1: application replay is idempotent and does not create another grant or trip
B2: the actual tool factory rejects a non-owner and a group context
B3: wrong account
B4: wrong sender in same session
B5: wrong peer in same session
B6: wrong session
B7: quoted confirmation
B8: stale message
B9: bare confirmation
B10: denied confirmation
B11: expired proposal index cannot issue a grant
B12: expired grant cannot commit
B13: duplicate transport message is deduplicated by the real Host
B14: actual planning tools propose and commit through Host confirmation
B15: Profile confirmation does not authorize pending Planning or Reminder
B16: wrong payload hash cannot issue a grant or change a trip
B17: committed proposal remains idempotent in a fresh process
